description: This is an HTML file that implements a web-based database visualizer interface, including UI components, styling, and client-side scripting for fetching and displaying database and table data dynamically.
external_methods: fetchData (fetch API calls for data retrieval)

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases and populates the sidebar

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes database list and resets UI state

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses database to show tables

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for selected database and displays them

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and displays data for selected table

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders data as an HTML table, handling wide content and nested objects

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling nulls, objects, and truncation

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for full view
